audit_status.source_base: Hebrew Numbers / Bemidbar Midian-war, captives, purification, and spoil-division text tradition, draft aligned later
audit_status.review_note: First-pass draft reviewed for vengeance-war command, Phinehas and trumpets, killing of Midianite males and kings, Balaam's death, captive women and children, Moses' further killing command, retained girls, corpse purification, metal purification, spoil division, tribute, and officers' gold memorial. Maximum anti-genocide, anti-child-killing, anti-sexual-violence, anti-xenophobia, and anti-plunder safeguards required.

verses.restored: YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

familiar.text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

modern.text: And the LORD said to Moses,

original.text: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר

verses.restored: Avenge vengeance of children of Israel upon Midianites; afterward you shall be gathered to your people.

familiar.text: Avenge the children of Israel of the Midianites: afterward shalt thou be gathered unto thy people.

modern.text: “Take vengeance on the Midianites for the Israelites. After that, you will be gathered to your people.”

original.text: נְקֹ֗ם נִקְמַת֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל מֵאֵ֖ת הַמִּדְיָנִ֑ים אַחַ֖ר תֵּאָסֵ֥ף אֶל עַמֶּֽיךָ

verses.restored: Moses spoke to people, saying, Arm men from among you for host, and let them be against Midian to give vengeance of YHWH upon Midian.

familiar.text: And Moses spake unto the people, saying, Arm some of yourselves unto the war, and let them go against the Midianites, and avenge the LORD of Midian.

modern.text: So Moses told the people, “Arm some of your men for war, that they may go against the Midianites and execute the LORD’s vengeance on them.

original.text: וַיְדַבֵּ֤ר מֹשֶׁה֙ אֶל הָעָ֣ם לֵאמֹ֔ר הֵחָלְצ֧וּ מֵאִתְּכֶ֛ם אֲנָשִׁ֖ים לַצָּבָ֑א וְיִהְיוּ֙ עַל מִדְיָ֔ן לָתֵ֥ת נִקְמַת יְהוָ֖ה בְּמִדְיָֽן

verses.restored: One thousand from each tribe, from all tribes of Israel, you shall send to host.

familiar.text: Of every tribe a thousand, throughout all the tribes of Israel, shall ye send to the war.

modern.text: Send into battle a thousand men from each tribe of Israel.”

original.text: אֶ֚לֶף לַמַּטֶּ֔ה אֶ֖לֶף לַמַּטֶּ֑ה לְכֹל֙ מַטּ֣וֹת יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל תִּשְׁלְח֖וּ לַצָּבָֽא

verses.restored: From thousands of Israel were delivered one thousand from each tribe, twelve thousand armed for war.

familiar.text: So there were delivered out of the thousands of Israel, a thousand of every tribe, twelve thousand armed for war.

modern.text: So a thousand men were recruited from each tribe of Israel—twelve thousand armed for war.

original.text: וַיִּמָּֽסְרוּ֙ מֵאַלְפֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֶ֖לֶף לַמַּטֶּ֑ה שְׁנֵים עָשָׂ֥ר אֶ֖לֶף חֲלוּצֵ֥י צָבָֽא

verses.restored: Moses sent them, one thousand from each tribe, to host, them and Phinehas son of Eleazar the priest, to host, with vessels of holy place and trumpets for alarm in his hand.

familiar.text: And Moses sent them to the war, a thousand of every tribe, them and Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest, to the war, with the holy instruments, and the trumpets to blow in his hand.

modern.text: And Moses sent the thousand from each tribe into battle, along with Phinehas son of Eleazar the priest, who took with him the vessels of the sanctuary and the trumpets for signaling.

original.text: וַיִּשְׁלַ֨ח אֹתָ֥ם מֹשֶׁ֛ה אֶ֥לֶף לַמַּטֶּ֖ה לַצָּבָ֑א אֹ֠תָם וְאֶת פִּ֨ינְחָ֜ס בֶּן אֶלְעָזָ֤ר הַכֹּהֵן֙ לַצָּבָ֔א וּכְלֵ֥י הַקֹּ֛דֶשׁ וַחֲצֹצְר֥וֹת הַתְּרוּעָ֖ה בְּיָדֽוֹ

verses.restored: They warred against Midian as YHWH commanded Moses, and they killed every male.

familiar.text: And they warred against the Midianites, as the LORD commanded Moses; and they slew all the males.

modern.text: Then they waged war against Midian, as the LORD had commanded Moses, and they killed every male.

original.text: וַֽיִּצְבְּאוּ֙ עַל מִדְיָ֔ן כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת מֹשֶׁ֑ה וַיַּֽהַרְג֖וּ כָּל זָכָֽר

verses.restored: They killed kings of Midian with their slain: Evi, Rekem, Zur, Hur, and Reba, five kings of Midian; and Balaam son of Beor they killed with sword.

familiar.text: And they slew the kings of Midian, beside the rest of them that were slain; namely, Evi, and Rekem, and Zur, and Hur, and Reba, five kings of Midian: Balaam also the son of Beor they slew with the sword.

modern.text: Among the slain were Evi, Rekem, Zur, Hur, and Reba—the five kings of Midian. They also killed Balaam son of Beor with the sword.

original.text: וְאֶת מַלְכֵ֨י מִדְיָ֜ן הָרְג֣וּ עַל חַלְלֵיהֶ֗ם אֶת אֱוִ֤י וְאֶת רֶ֨קֶם֙ וְאֶת צ֤וּר וְאֶת חוּר֙ וְאֶת רֶ֔בַע חֲמֵ֖שֶׁת מַלְכֵ֣י מִדְיָ֑ן וְאֵת֙ בִּלְעָ֣ם בֶּן בְּע֔וֹר הָרְג֖וּ בֶּחָֽרֶב

verses.restored: Children of Israel took captive women of Midian and their little ones, and all their cattle, all their livestock, and all their wealth they plundered.

familiar.text: And the children of Israel took all the women of Midian captives, and their little ones, and took the spoil of all their cattle, and all their flocks, and all their goods.

modern.text: The Israelites captured the Midianite women and their children, and they plundered all their herds, flocks, and goods.

original.text: וַיִּשְׁבּ֧וּ בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל אֶת נְשֵׁ֥י מִדְיָ֖ן וְאֶת טַפָּ֑ם וְאֵ֨ת כָּל בְּהֶמְתָּ֧ם וְאֶת כָּל מִקְנֵהֶ֛ם וְאֶת כָּל חֵילָ֖ם בָּזָֽזוּ

verses.restored: All their cities in their settlements and all their encampments they burned with fire.

familiar.text: And they burnt all their cities wherein they dwelt, and all their goodly castles, with fire.

modern.text: Then they burned all the cities where the Midianites had lived, as well as all their encampments,

original.text: וְאֵ֤ת כָּל עָרֵיהֶם֙ בְּמ֣וֹשְׁבֹתָ֔ם וְאֵ֖ת כָּל טִֽירֹתָ֑ם שָׂרְפ֖וּ בָּאֵֽשׁ

verses.restored: They took all spoil and all prey, human and beast,

familiar.text: And they took all the spoil, and all the prey, both of men and of beasts.

modern.text: and carried away all the plunder and spoils, both people and animals.

original.text: וַיִּקְחוּ֙ אֶת כָּל הַשָּׁלָ֔ל וְאֵ֖ת כָּל הַמַּלְק֑וֹחַ בָּאָדָ֖ם וּבַבְּהֵמָֽה

verses.restored: and brought captives, prey, and spoil to Moses and Eleazar the priest and congregation of children of Israel, to camp at plains of Moab by Jordan at Jericho.

familiar.text: And they brought the captives, and the prey, and the spoil, unto Moses, and Eleazar the priest, and unto the congregation of the children of Israel, unto the camp at the plains of Moab, which are by Jordan near Jericho.

modern.text: They brought the captives, spoils, and plunder to Moses, to Eleazar the priest, and to the congregation of Israel at the camp on the plains of Moab, by the Jordan across from Jericho.

original.text: וַיָּבִ֡אוּ אֶל מֹשֶׁה֩ וְאֶל אֶלְעָזָ֨ר הַכֹּהֵ֜ן וְאֶל עֲדַ֣ת בְּנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל אֶת הַשְּׁבִ֧י וְאֶת הַמַּלְק֛וֹחַ וְאֶת הַשָּׁלָ֖ל אֶל הַֽמַּחֲנֶ֑ה אֶל עַֽרְבֹ֣ת מוֹאָ֔ב אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל יַרְדֵּ֥ן יְרֵחֽוֹ

modern.text: And Moses, Eleazar the priest, and all the leaders of the congregation went to meet them outside the camp.

modern.text: But Moses was angry with the officers of the army—the commanders of thousands and commanders of hundreds—who were returning from the battle.

modern.text: “Have you spared all the women?” he asked them.

modern.text: “Look, these women caused the sons of Israel, through the counsel of Balaam, to turn unfaithfully against the LORD at Peor, so that the plague struck the congregation of the LORD.

familiar.text: Now therefore kill every male among the little ones, and kill every woman that hath known man by lying with him.

modern.text: So now, kill all the boys, as well as every woman who has had relations with a man,

modern.text: but spare for yourselves every girl who has never had relations with a man.

original.text: וְכֹל֙ הַטַּ֣ף בַּנָּשִׁ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא יָדְע֖וּ מִשְׁכַּ֣ב זָכָ֑ר הַחֲי֖וּ לָכֶֽם

verses.restored: You, camp outside camp seven days; everyone who killed a soul/life and everyone who touched slain, purify yourselves on third day and seventh day, you and your captives.

modern.text: All of you who have killed a person or touched the dead are to remain outside the camp for seven days. On the third day and the seventh day you are to purify both yourselves and your captives.

modern.text: And purify every garment and leather good, everything made of goat’s hair, and every article of wood.”

modern.text: Then Eleazar the priest said to the soldiers who had gone into battle, “This is the statute of the law which the LORD has commanded Moses:

modern.text: Only the gold, silver, bronze, iron, tin, and lead—

familiar.text: Every thing that may abide the fire, ye shall make it go through the fire, and it shall be clean: nevertheless it shall be purified with the water of separation: and all that abideth not the fire ye shall make go through the water.

modern.text: everything that can withstand the fire—must be put through the fire, and it will be clean. But it must still be purified with the water of purification. And everything that cannot withstand the fire must pass through the water.

original.text: כָּל דָּבָ֞ר אֲשֶׁר יָבֹ֣א בָאֵ֗שׁ תַּעֲבִ֤ירוּ בָאֵשׁ֙ וְטָהֵ֔ר אַ֕ךְ בְּמֵ֥י נִדָּ֖ה יִתְחַטָּ֑א וְכֹ֨ל אֲשֶׁ֧ר לֹֽא יָבֹ֛א בָּאֵ֖שׁ תַּעֲבִ֥ירוּ בַמָּֽיִם

modern.text: On the seventh day you are to wash your clothes, and you will be clean. After that you may enter the camp.” Division of the Spoils

modern.text: The LORD said to Moses,

verses.restored: Lift up head/count of prey taken, human and beast, you and Eleazar the priest and heads of fathers' houses of congregation.

familiar.text: Take the sum of the prey that was taken, both of man and of beast, thou, and Eleazar the priest, and the chief fathers of the congregation:

modern.text: “You and Eleazar the priest and the family heads of the congregation are to take a count of what was captured, both of man and beast.

original.text: שָׂ֗א אֵ֣ת רֹ֤אשׁ מַלְק֨וֹחַ֙ הַשְּׁבִ֔י בָּאָדָ֖ם וּבַבְּהֵמָ֑ה אַתָּה֙ וְאֶלְעָזָ֣ר הַכֹּהֵ֔ן וְרָאשֵׁ֖י אֲב֥וֹת הָעֵדָֽה

verses.restored: Divide prey into halves between those who handled war, who went out to host, and all congregation.

familiar.text: And divide the prey into two parts; between them that took the war upon them, who went out to battle, and between all the congregation:

modern.text: Then divide the captives between the troops who went out to battle and the rest of the congregation.

original.text: וְחָצִ֨יתָ֙ אֶת הַמַּלְק֔וֹחַ בֵּ֚ין תֹּפְשֵׂ֣י הַמִּלְחָמָ֔ה הַיֹּצְאִ֖ים לַצָּבָ֑א וּבֵ֖ין כָּל הָעֵדָֽה

verses.restored: Levy tribute for YHWH from men of war who went out to host: one soul/life from five hundred, from humans, cattle, donkeys, and flock.

familiar.text: And levy a tribute unto the Lord of the men of war which went out to battle: one soul of five hundred, both of the persons, and of the beeves, and of the asses, and of the sheep:

modern.text: Set aside a tribute for the LORD from what belongs to the soldiers who went into battle: one out of every five hundred, whether persons, cattle, donkeys, or sheep.

verses.restored: From their half you shall take it and give it to Eleazar the priest as contribution of YHWH.

familiar.text: Take it of their half, and give it unto Eleazar the priest, for an heave offering of the LORD.

modern.text: Take it from their half and give it to Eleazar the priest as an offering to the LORD.

original.text: מִמַּֽחֲצִיתָ֖ם תִּקָּ֑חוּ וְנָתַתָּ֛ה לְאֶלְעָזָ֥ר הַכֹּהֵ֖ן תְּרוּמַ֥ת יְהוָֽה

verses.restored: From half belonging to children of Israel you shall take one taken from fifty, from humans, cattle, donkeys, flock, and every beast, and give them to Levites who keep charge of dwelling-place of YHWH.

translation_notes: Numbers 31 is a conquest-and-captive narrative of extreme moral danger. Its commands to kill males, boys, and sexually experienced women must be preserved without euphemism and categorically rejected as models for modern conduct.

Verse 18 retains girls described as not having known a male 'for yourselves.' The text does not explain their future treatment; histories of captivity make sexual exploitation a grave concern that must not be minimized.
Women are blamed through the Peor interpretation, but Israelite men remain moral agents and Balaam is named as counselor. Women and foreign peoples must not become collective scapegoats.
Human captives are counted and divided alongside animals and goods. This dehumanizing structure must not be normalized as timeless Divine economics.
Corpse and object purification acknowledges contamination after killing but does not morally cleanse genocide, enslavement, sexual violence, or plunder.
The officers' claim that no Israelite soldier was missing and their gold memorial reflects the victors' perspective; it does not erase Midianite suffering.
Midianite identity in this chapter must not be mapped onto modern Arab, Muslim, Indigenous, or other populations.
safety_note: Never use Numbers 31 to justify genocide, child killing, enslavement, captive marriage, sexual violence, ethnic cleansing, religious war, collective punishment, or looting. This chapter must be received as severe ancient war material under categorical moral protest, with the humanity of Midianite women, children, and communities kept visible.
